probes.description: Initialize the public MCP session and discover readiness, capacity, and the supported control tools.
Create a session, materialize its Agent with one bounded deterministic offline Run, and verify the durable list projection twice without retaining real identifiers.
Submit one finite Run with explicit limits and observe a host-authored terminal state plus complete structural provider accounting.
Exercise steering and explicit cancellation through public controls and require a durable cancelled terminal state.
Create one bounded no-tool Run, disconnect, reinitialize MCP, and recover ordered events from the recorded cursor.
Create one bounded no-tool Run, restart the owned service, and re-read its durable Run and cursor-addressed events through fresh MCP.
Create one bounded no-tool Run, then inspect its persisted checkpoint and lineage without issuing a resume operation.
Drive create, offer, accept, claim, lease heartbeat, progress, and completion through MCP.
Expire a claimed Work lease under deterministic time and verify one policy-bounded retry without duplicate completion.
Create dependent Work, prove it remains blocked, complete the prerequisite, and observe deterministic unblocking.
Verify approval-gated Work cannot proceed before an explicit decision, then cover approval and cancellation terminal paths.
Replay an identical idempotent Work request and reject reuse of its request identity with a changed payload.
Create an enabled Routine, fire one manual activation, and inspect the durable activation projection.
Advance a deterministic clock across one schedule boundary and require at most one durable activation.
Replay the same manual activation request and prove the existing Activation is returned without duplicate Work.
Pause and disable a Routine and prove neither state permits a new activation until it is explicitly enabled.
Restart an owned service after activation admission and prove the durable Routine and Activation projections recover once.
Discover scoped workers and renew one worker heartbeat using only public coordinator controls.
Create parent and child Work records and verify durable lineage and workspace scope in their public projections.
Exchange typed question, answer, handoff, and review messages between scoped synthetic worker identities.
Create two test Agents and one typed message, then reconnect the inbox consumer from its prior cursor without duplicates or gaps.
Replay an identical message and deterministically advance past its expiry while preserving exactly-once visibility.
Attempt a coordinator mutation across the configured workspace boundary and require a typed rejection with no durable creation.
Create a fresh Agent and, when native managed execution is discoverable, prove its managed policy remains disabled until explicitly configured.
Capability-gated future probe linking one Routine or coordinator Work item to one finite native Run.

Capability-gated live probe that creates two independent fresh Work, Run, intent, and real permission cases, pre-authorizes each Work, allows one permission, denies the other, and proves missing, dead, or wrong-Run resolution fails closed without unparking Work; no permission is transitioned to both decisions.

Capability-gated live probe proving retryEligible=false closes one failed native Run, attempt, and intent; ptah_retry_work queues the Work, repeated native ticks create no second native Run or attempt, an external worker can claim it, and the original failed attempt remains inspectable.

Capability-gated live probe with retryEligible=false that observes one admitted native Run before an owned restart, then proves only the public Run interrupted, attempt expired, Work failed, and intent finalized convergence with reconnect, no implicit invocation resume, and no duplicate Run; it makes no internal crash-stage or adoption claim.

Capability-gated live probe replaying the public Work create and assignment request IDs, observing repeated native supervisor ticks, and proving exactly one Work, one admitted intent, one attempt, and one linked native Run through public Work, attempt, intent, and Run projections.
Repeat bounded Work, Routine, and message cycles with scheduled owned restarts, reconnects, invariant snapshots, and leak checks.
